note: nanoid's default: long enough to be unique, short enough to be reasonable
an underscore is not a letter or numeral
neither is a hyphen; both are left out of the alphabet so a double-click selects a whole tag
a trailing newline; python's $ anchor would accept this, which is why the python edition uses fullmatch
an accented letter; the alphabet is ascii, and this is 21 bytes but not 21 letters
returns the tag, so a call can pass a valid tag through
a guard: an invalid tag is a bug in the caller, and the edition fails loudly in its own way
blank is not a tag either
